retention_policy: Controlled accumulation of earlier live states by card_key, keeping greatest card timestamp; not the original final snapshot. No deletion/tombstone semantics implemented.

retained_cards_full.backstory: Jessica Martinez called USPS Passport Services on 2024-06-15 to inquire about renewing her passport. She was considering renewal due to a possible work trip to Tokyo, Japan in December 2024 or January 2025. She had not yet decided to renew and would wait until the trip was confirmed, but noted the October 2024 submission deadline for expedited processing. On 2024-11-22, during a Delta Airlines booking call, she decided to renew her passport before the trip due to the close expiration date relative to her return.

facts.renewal_decision: decided to renew before January 2025 trip
facts.mail_renewal_payment_method: check or money order payable to US Department of State
facts.mailing_address_for_expedited: National Passport Processing Center, Post Office Box 90955, Philadelphia, PA 19190-0955
facts.photo_requirements: 2x2 inches, white background, taken within last 6 months, neutral expression, no glasses unless medically necessary, no hats/head coverings unless religious
facts.tracking_method: travel.state.gov, updates within 2 weeks of receipt
facts.urgent_travel_appointment: available if travel within 14 days, nearest agency at 11000 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 1000, Los Angeles, appointments mandatory
facts.passport_book_size: standard 28-page book, 52-page available at same price
facts.name_change_requirement: proof of name change (marriage certificate or court order) if applicable
facts.japan_visa_requirement: no visa for US citizens for stays up to 90 days (tourism/business)
facts.japan_entry_requirements: proof of onward travel and sufficient funds (return ticket and credit card usually sufficient), no required vaccinations, COVID restrictions mostly lifted but verify closer to travel

retained_cards_full.backstory: Jessica Martinez called Delta Airlines Reservations on 2024-11-22 to book a business class flight to Tokyo for a business conference. She chose Haneda Airport for proximity to downtown Tokyo. She booked non-stop flights DL 7 and DL 8, paying with her corporate American Express. She was advised to renew her passport before travel due to the close expiration date.

facts.cancellation_policy: fully refundable if cancelled 24 hours before departure
facts.change_policy: no change fees, fare difference applies
facts.baggage_allowance: 2 free checked bags up to 70 pounds each, plus carry-on and personal item
facts.boarding_pass: mobile boarding passes available 24 hours before departure
facts.meal_service: full meal service, pre-selection available 30 days before departure
facts.dietary_options: vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and other options
facts.hotel_booking: to be handled separately by customer

retained_cards_full.backstory: Jessica Martinez called Chase Bank Credit Card Services on 2024-10-05 to confirm her Chase Sapphire Reserve card would work internationally for upcoming work trips. She learned about international usage, travel insurance, lounge access, and updated her autopay to full balance.

facts.international_usage: works worldwide, chip and PIN capable
facts.fraud_verification_method: Chase mobile app for flagged transactions
facts.travel_insurance: trip cancellation up to $10,000, trip delay reimbursement, lost luggage coverage, emergency medical
facts.business_trip_coverage: covered only if trip paid with Sapphire Reserve; airline ticket paid with corporate AmEx not covered
facts.rental_car_insurance: primary coverage when paid with card, decline rental company insurance
facts.priority_pass_card_status: physical card location unknown, digital card available in Priority Pass app
facts.priority_pass_guest_policy: up to 2 guests free per visit
facts.chase_sapphire_lounges: Boston, Hong Kong, New York LaGuardia; more coming; not at LAX
facts.cash_advance_recommendation: avoid, high fees and immediate interest; use Chase debit card at ATMs instead
facts.debit_card_international_usage: works at ATMs with Visa or Plus logos
facts.japan_atm_recommendations: 7-Eleven ATMs and Japan Post Bank ATMs
facts.dynamic_currency_conversion_advice: always choose local currency, decline USD conversion
facts.payment_due_date: 25 days after statement close, around 22nd of following month
facts.autopay_status: changed from minimum payment to full balance, starting next statement, from Chase checking
facts.points_earning: 3x on travel and dining worldwide, 1x on everything else
facts.travel_category_includes: hotels, airlines, car rentals, trains, taxis, Uber abroad
facts.points_value: 1.5 cents each via Chase Ultimate Rewards for travel, more if transferred to partners
facts.transfer_partners: United, Southwest, JetBlue, Hyatt, Marriott, IHG, and several international airlines
facts.delta_transfer_route: not direct; transfer to Air France/KLM Flying Blue and book Delta flights through them
